description: Source code for the Android AudioSystem class, managing audio hardware interfaces, volume, routing, and effects.

classes.name: AudioFlingerClient
classes.description: Client class for handling death and configuration changes of the AudioFlinger service.

classes.name: AudioPolicyServiceClient
classes.description: Client class for handling death of the AudioPolicyService.

methods.name: get_audio_flinger
methods.description: Establishes and returns the binder interface to the AudioFlinger service, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: muteMicrophone
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the microphone.

methods.name: isMicrophoneMuted
methods.description: Checks if the microphone is muted.

methods.name: setMasterVolume
methods.description: Sets the master volume level.

methods.name: setMasterMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the master volume.

methods.name: getMasterVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current master volume level.

methods.name: getMasterMute
methods.description: Checks if the master volume is muted.

methods.name: setStreamVolume
methods.description: Sets volume for a specific audio stream.

methods.name: setStreamMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes a specific audio stream.

methods.name: getStreamVolume
methods.description: Retrieves volume for a specific audio stream.

methods.name: getStreamMute
methods.description: Checks if a specific audio stream is muted.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the audio mode.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets parameters for a specific audio IO handle.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Retrieves parameters for a specific audio IO handle.

methods.name: linearToLog
methods.description: Converts linear volume steps to logarithmic scale.

methods.name: logToLinear
methods.description: Converts logarithmic volume scale to linear steps.

methods.name: getOutputSamplingRate
methods.description: Retrieves the sampling rate of an output stream.

methods.name: getSamplingRate
methods.description: Gets the sampling rate for a specific output handle.

methods.name: getOutputFrameCount
methods.description: Retrieves the frame count of an output stream.

methods.name: getFrameCount
methods.description: Gets the frame count for a specific output handle.

methods.name: getOutputLatency
methods.description: Retrieves the latency of an output stream.

methods.name: getLatency
methods.description: Gets the latency for a specific output handle.

methods.name: getInputBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates the input buffer size based on sample rate, format, and channels.

methods.name: setVoiceVolume
methods.description: Sets the voice volume.

methods.name: getRenderPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current render position.

methods.name: getInputFramesLost
methods.description: Returns the number of input frames lost.

methods.name: newAudioSessionId
methods.description: Generates a new audio session ID.

methods.name: acquireAudioSessionId
methods.description: Acquires a specific audio session ID.

methods.name: releaseAudioSessionId
methods.description: Releases a specific audio session ID.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles death of the binder service for AudioFlinger or AudioPolicyService.

methods.name: ioConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes for audio IO outputs.

methods.name: setErrorCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for audio errors.

methods.name: routedToA2dpOutput
methods.description: Checks if a stream is routed to A2DP output.

methods.name: get_audio_policy_service
methods.description: Establishes and returns the binder interface to the AudioPolicyService.

methods.name: setDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Sets the connection state of an audio device.

methods.name: getDeviceConnectionState
methods.description: Retrieves the connection state of an audio device.

methods.name: setPhoneState
methods.description: Sets the phone (call) state.

methods.name: setForceUse
methods.description: Sets forced usage configuration for audio routing.

methods.name: getForceUse
methods.description: Retrieves forced usage configuration.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Gets an output handle for a given stream and configuration.

methods.name: startOutput
methods.description: Starts an output stream.

methods.name: stopOutput
methods.description: Stops an output stream.

methods.name: releaseOutput
methods.description: Releases an output handle.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Gets an input handle for a given source and configuration.

methods.name: startInput
methods.description: Starts an input stream.

methods.name: stopInput
methods.description: Stops an input stream.

methods.name: releaseInput
methods.description: Releases an input handle.

methods.name: initStreamVolume
methods.description: Initializes volume range for a stream.

methods.name: setStreamVolumeIndex
methods.description: Sets volume index for a stream and device.

methods.name: getStreamVolumeIndex
methods.description: Gets volume index for a stream and device.

methods.name: getStrategyForStream
methods.description: Retrieves the audio routing strategy for a stream.

methods.name: getDevicesForStream
methods.description: Retrieves devices associated with a stream.

methods.name: getOutputForEffect
methods.description: Gets output handle suitable for an effect.

methods.name: registerEffect
methods.description: Registers an audio effect.

methods.name: unregisterEffect
methods.description: Unregisters an audio effect.

methods.name: setEffectEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an effect.

methods.name: isStreamActive
methods.description: Checks if a stream is active.

methods.name: clearAudioConfigCache
methods.description: Clears cached audio configuration data.
